# Black Mint

> Paid Ads. AI Systems. Growth.

Black Mint is a performance marketing and AI automation company for small and medium businesses. The company helps businesses get more customers through paid ads, AI assistants, automation, landing pages, creative testing, tracking, dashboards and growth systems. Minimum monthly ad spend: $500.

## Core Pages

- Ukrainian homepage: https://black-mint.net/
- English homepage: https://black-mint.net/en/
- Sitemap: https://black-mint.net/sitemap.xml

## Services

- Paid acquisition: Meta Ads, TikTok Ads and Google Ads campaigns focused on leads, sales and return on ad spend.
- Automation: repeated lead handling actions, follow-up, notifications and simple process scenarios.
- AI assistants: assistants for first replies, consultations, bookings and faster lead response.
- Analytics and reporting: dashboards and tracking for CPL, CAC, ROAS and funnel performance.
- Conversion optimization: improvements to offers, landing page structure, forms and drop-off points.
- SEO and content: service pages and content foundations for organic traffic after the first paid launch.
- Landing pages: fast campaign pages for offers, products and demand testing.
- Creative Lab: hooks, messages, creative hypotheses and ad format testing.

## Free Audit

Black Mint offers a short audit for businesses with monthly ad spend from $500. The audit reviews ads, website, creatives, lead response speed and sales funnel. The expected output is 3–5 growth points, funnel bottlenecks and a first action plan.

## Target Customers

Black Mint works with small and medium businesses, including services, local businesses, e-commerce, online education, clinics, salons and B2B companies that rely on leads and advertising efficiency.

## Differentiation

Most agencies launch ads. Black Mint builds a business growth system that combines traffic, landing pages, creative testing, automation and analytics across the full customer journey.

- Brand: Black Mint
- Slogan: Paid Ads. AI Systems. Growth.
